modality_notes.xray: Lobar opacification obscuring vascular markings, silhouette sign
modality_notes.ct: Consolidation with air bronchograms, ground-glass halo, small effusion
modality_notes.us: Sub-pleural consolidation with air bronchograms (shred sign)

modality_notes.mri: T1 hypointense, T2/FLAIR hyperintense with surrounding edema, ring enhancement on T1+C
modality_notes.ct: Hypodense to isodense mass with surrounding vasogenic edema

modality_notes.us: Increased echogenicity (bright liver), poor penetration of sound waves
modality_notes.ct: Liver density lower than spleen on non-contrast CT (< 40 HU)
